## Day 3 notes
## Vectorization and lists

```{r}
##install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()
```

```{r}
sum(x[[1]]) # will succeed

sum(x[1]) # will error
```

```{r}
x <- list(a = 1:3, b = "hello", c = list(d = TRUE))
sum(x[[1]])
x[[1,2]]
```

```{r}
#Just an example
cms <- sample_n(tidyr::cms_patient_care, size = 4)
cms
```

```{r}
## Just an example
cms |> 
  mutate(metadata = list(
    women,
    vec = c("ab", "c"),
    lm(height ~ weight, data = women),
    NULL
  ), .after = ccn)
```

```{r}
counts <- counts <- c(100, 307, 323, 5000, 0, 10)
log10(counts)
make_loggable <- function(raw_counts) {
    raw_counts +1
}
 counts |>  make_loggable() |>  log10()
```
